display_name: 源相关后验与 DURA 互补性诊断
description: 仅在合法源 pilot，使用同条 clean IQ 求 DURA 到相关后验方向的受限理想步长，检验若干物理后验是否有互补线性方向；所有步长均不可部署。

data.representation: source paired received/clean IQ, source clean second moment, simulated source action/variance

roles.L_s: source IQ pair, no TX identity
roles.U_s: source IQ pair, TX identity hidden

permissions.claim_scope: Source-only IQ NMSE and solver residual; true source action is privileged and not a theoretical upper bound or TX accuracy

checkpoint.initialization: Frozen original DURA v1.0 plus source-only IQ second moment fitted from fixed 8192 source IDs
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: frozen_dura source-only provenance and epoch19 matching source action cache
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Original source-only DURA, no F or target ancestry
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed shrinkage 0.1 and 40 CG iterations for all preregistered variants; no target selection

expected_artifacts: result.json per-source-scene IQ NMSE, paired changes and actual CG residual
source_covariance.pt: source-only aggregate prior, kept on [计算环境]

metric_names: source per-record ideal positive and signed blend IQ NMSE
dimensions: RX4/6 and RX8 by seven source views
true action/true noise and estimated action/estimated noise

rows.method: Three frozen posterior directions, DURA anchor and source-clean privileged per-record positive [0,.5] or signed [-.5,.5] normalized line minimization
rows.purpose: Bound the source IQ benefit of fixed posterior directions as a preliminary complement diagnostic
rows.seed_notes: Fixed source fit selection 2026110611, original DURA seed 2026092701, fixed source pilot; no target access or parameter optimizer.
rows.scenario: source pilot epochs19, seven fixed views
expected_artifacts: result.json per-source-scene IQ NMSE, paired changes and actual CG residual
source_covariance.pt: source-only aggregate prior, kept on [计算环境]

notes: No F, TX labels, V, target IQ/truth, or model updates; fit uses only legal source IQ.
True simulator action and variance are privileged source-only quantities, never available to the deployable model; this restricted Gaussian diagnostic is not an upper bound.
Source second moment and source pilot use previously explored domains; DURA may have seen these domains.
Output includes true recomputed CG residual; finite-iteration errors can affect comparisons.
No target performance data will select or rank candidates.
40-step source run showed high true residual for some correlated-prior records; this preregistered follow-up tests numerical convergence only, without target data.

Source-only 160-step results showed a gap between paired true-action/true-noise and estimated-action/estimated-noise, which does not identify either factor; this fixed 2x2 intervention separates them.

All line steps use the matched source clean IQ, including estimated-action variants; every oracle step is nondeployable. Bounds apply only to tested directions and fixed step range, not to general methods or target identity.
